title: Technical Director – Tech Disciplines (BIM)
purpose: Governs and aligns all Tech Discipline Leads (Controls, Lighting, Mechanical, Electrical, Audio, Video, Show Control, Network/IT interfaces) to deliver coherent, milestone-ready BIM outputs. Serves as TECH portfolio counterpart to Project Manager within BIM forums, orchestrating standards adherence, cross-discipline coordination, milestone readiness, and risk escalation.
authority_statements: Enforces adoption of governed BIM standards and validation pipelines across TECH disciplines
Arbitrates conflicts in standards interpretation with Tech Discipline Leads and BIM Manager
Approves portfolio-level scope representations and readiness criteria for TECH deliverables at milestones
Holds authority to halt release if correctness thresholds are not met
Defines minimum completeness and accuracy thresholds for TECH schedules, models, and schematics prior to publishing
Sets and maintains interface contracts among TECH disciplines and with external scopes
Does not replace Discipline Leads' technical authorship or approve engineering details
Does not act as BIM Manager/Coordinator
Does not own non-TECH scopes (civil, architectural, structural)
responsibilities: Participate in all project BIM meetings where TECH is involved; present portfolio status and impacts
Coordinate with client and consultants on TECH matters, ensuring decisions are reflected in models and schedules
Drive regular TECH team reviews of federated models in ACC; prioritize and assign clash resolution to Discipline Leads
Verify interface consistency across TECH models (power, control, data, clearances, mounts)
Align with BIM Manager and Coordinator on BEP, model exchange cadence, issue tracking, and validation dashboards
Set weekly priorities across TECH disciplines; sequence work to reduce blockers and protect interfaces
Work with Technical PM and production team to set and maintain TECH BIM schedules and freeze windows
Confirm readiness criteria per release (drawings locked, data drops validated, change logs captured)
accountabilities: Aggregate fitness-for-purpose of TECH BIM deliverables at each milestone (models, drawings, schedules, data drops)
Ensuring TECH is represented in all relevant BIM meetings and progress/risks are reported
Ensuring TECH team conducts federated reviews, resolves priority clashes, and tracks issues to closure in CDE
Synthesizing TECH BIM status and risks for Technical PM / PM
approvals: TECH readiness criteria and priority issue lists
inputs: Project milestone schedule and delivery commitments from PM
Validation dashboards and BEP rules from Project BIM Manager
Federated model clash logs from ACC
Discipline BIM outputs from Tech Discipline Leads
outputs: TECH federated review issue backlog and priorities
TECH portfolio status and risk reports
interfaces_with_roles: Tech Discipline Leads (Controls, Audio, Video, Lighting, Mechanical, Electrical, SFX)
